title: Load tipper firmware via HMI USB dongle
summary: Update the tipper controller firmware using a USB drive and then reboot the controller to boot normally and reach the expected HMI screens (Visu_Default, then Visu_MCP_Dual).
when_to_use: Use when you need to load new firmware onto the tipper controller via the HMI USB dongle and then reboot so the HMI returns to the normal commissioning/operator screens.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the power-off/power-on sequence using the tipper disconnect and uses the tipper HMI to load firmware from the USB dongle.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper disconnect to turn off power
USB drive containing the new version of firmware
INSTALL FROM FILE button on the HMI

system_preconditions: Tipper controller is accessible for power control via the disconnect.
USB drive with the intended firmware version is available and can be plugged into the USB dongle on the HMI.

visual_references.description: Photograph of the Tipper Machine Control Panel ("Visu_MCP_Dual" screen) showing the primary operator interface buttons (AUTO, JOG, REF, CYCLE START, CYCLE STOP).
HMI screenshot showing the "Visu_Default" screen displaying IP and subnet mask settings after controller reboot.
HMI screenshot showing the gray screen appearance during the step where you hold the top buttons while powering on.

steps.title: Turn off power to the tipper using the disconnect
steps.purpose: Ensure the controller is fully powered down before entering the firmware-load mode.
steps.instruction: Turn off power to the tipper with the disconnect.
steps.expected_result: Tipper controller power is off (HMI is not in normal operation).
steps.healthy_condition: Controller is fully powered down and ready for the power-on sequence.
steps.failure_condition: Power is not fully removed (HMI remains active/normal).

actions.label: Power off via disconnect
actions.exact_action: Turn off power to the tipper with the disconnect.

steps.title: Enter firmware-load mode by holding the top three HMI buttons during power-on
steps.purpose: Trigger the HMI gray screen mode required to load firmware from USB.
steps.instruction: Press and hold the top three buttons on the HMI, then continue holding them while powering on the tipper.
steps.expected_result: A gray screen appears on the HMI while the top three buttons are still held.
steps.healthy_condition: Gray screen appears after power-on while holding the top three buttons.
steps.failure_condition: Gray screen does not appear while holding the top three buttons during power-on.

actions.label: Hold top three HMI buttons
actions.exact_action: Press and hold the top three buttons on the HMI.

actions.label: Power on while holding buttons
actions.exact_action: Continue to hold the buttons and power on the tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the gray screen does not appear while holding the top three HMI buttons during power-on, repeat the button-hold/power-on sequence as described.

steps.title: Plug USB drive into the HMI USB dongle
steps.purpose: Provide the firmware file to the controller for installation.
steps.instruction: Plug the USB drive containing the new version of firmware into the USB dongle on the HMI.
steps.expected_result: USB drive is physically connected to the HMI USB dongle while the gray screen mode is active.
steps.healthy_condition: USB drive is seated in the USB dongle and the HMI remains in the firmware-load mode.
steps.failure_condition: USB drive is not connected correctly (firmware installation cannot proceed).

actions.label: Insert USB drive
actions.exact_action: Plug the USB drive containing the new version of firmware into the USB dongle on the HMI.

steps.title: Start firmware installation from file
steps.purpose: Initiate the firmware load process from the USB drive.
steps.instruction: Press the INSTALL FROM FILE button, then load the firmware from the USB.
steps.expected_result: Firmware installation process begins and completes loading from the USB.
steps.healthy_condition: Firmware load proceeds successfully from the USB source.
steps.failure_condition: Firmware does not load from the USB (installation cannot proceed or fails).

actions.label: Press INSTALL FROM FILE
actions.exact_action: Press the INSTALL FROM FILE button.

actions.label: Load firmware from USB
actions.exact_action: Load the firmware from the USB.

steps.title: Power-cycle controller and allow normal boot without pressing buttons
steps.purpose: Reboot the controller so it boots normally using the newly loaded firmware.
steps.instruction: Power the controller off and back on. Allow the controller to boot normally: do not press any buttons.
steps.expected_result: Controller reboots normally without any button presses during boot.
steps.healthy_condition: Controller completes boot and transitions to the expected HMI screen (Visu_Default).
steps.failure_condition: Controller does not boot normally, or buttons are pressed during boot.

actions.label: Power off and back on
actions.exact_action: Power the controller off and back on.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the controller does not boot normally after power off/on (or if buttons are pressed during boot), repeat the power off/on step and ensure no buttons are pressed during boot.

steps.title: Verify Visu_Default screen appears with IP and subnet mask settings
steps.purpose: Confirm the controller is running correctly and the HMI is in the expected post-boot state.
steps.instruction: Verify the "Visu_Default" screen appears on the HMI displaying the IP and subnet mask settings.
steps.expected_result: HMI shows the "Visu_Default" screen with IP and subnet mask settings.
steps.healthy_condition: Visu_Default screen is visible and displays IP and subnet mask values.
steps.failure_condition: Visu_Default screen does not appear, or IP/subnet mask settings are not displayed as expected.

actions.label: Check Visu_Default screen
actions.exact_action: The "Visu_Default" screen will appear on the HMI displaying the IP and subnet mask settings.

steps.title: Navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual using F3
steps.purpose: Reach the primary tipper operator control screen after firmware load.
steps.instruction: Press F3 to go to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Visu_MCP_Dual screen is active (operator control panel visible).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F3 does not bring up Visu_MCP_Dual.

actions.label: Press F3
actions.exact_action: Press F3 to go to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.

success_criteria: After firmware load and controller reboot, the HMI displays the "Visu_Default" screen showing IP and subnet mask settings.
Pressing F3 brings up the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
healthy_conditions: HMI shows "Visu_Default" with IP and subnet mask settings.
HMI successfully navigates to "Visu_MCP_Dual" using F3.
failure_conditions: Gray screen does not appear while holding the top three HMI buttons during power-on.
Controller does not boot normally after power off/on, or buttons are pressed during boot.
Visu_Default screen does not appear or does not show IP and subnet mask settings.
F3 does not navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
escalation_guidance: If the gray screen does not appear, repeat the button-hold/power-on sequence as described.
If the controller does not boot normally after power off/on (or if buttons are pressed during boot), repeat the power off/on step and ensure no buttons are pressed during boot.
